iso.cybexos-desktop.x86_64: The ISO delivers the shared desktop payload as an RPM; checkout installs the same source through Ansible.
iso.cybexos-offline-apps.x86_64: The ISO delivers the shared application seed as an independently versioned RPM; checkout uses the same application roles.

checkout.gpg-pubkey.(none)=56f49901ab19baf099a95a: Exact Brave prerelease signing key shipped by signed brave-keyring 1.19-1 and imported by its background postinstall script on running Fedora. The ISO's initial chroot lacks timeout during that transaction, so its importer does not run. Both paths retain the same signed keyring package and pinned stable repository; no prerelease repository is enabled.
